testcase.name: TodoItemComponent should call onDelete when delete button is clicked
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-high" for high priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-medium" for medium priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-low" for low priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-low" as default for unknown priority
TodoItemComponent should display the todo text and completion status
TodoItemComponent should create
TodoItemComponent should call onToggle when checkbox is changed
TodoItemComponent should not have completed class when todo is not completed
GodService Todo Management should not change todos when toggling a non-existing todo
GodService Todo Management should delete an existing todo
GodService Todo Management should toggle an existing todo completion status
GodService Todo Management should add a new todo
GodService Todo Management should not change todos when deleting a non-existing todo
GodService Todo Management should get initial todos
GodService Configuration Management should get config value
GodService Configuration Management should log when updating config
GodService should be created
GodService Product Management should log when adding a product
GodService Product Management should get products
GodService User Management should get users
GodService User Management should log when adding a user
GodService Logging should call console.log with a formatted message
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent importantTodos computed signal should filter for high priority, incomplete todos and sort them by id
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent importantTodos computed signal should be empty if there are no high priority, incomplete todos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent importantTodos computed signal should update when the source todos signal changes
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos method should return all todos sorted if no filters are provided
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos method should filter by medium priority
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos method should filter by completion status only
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos method should filter by both priority and completion
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent filterAndProcessTodos method should filter by priority only
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent Template rendering should display the list when there are important todos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent Template rendering should display a message when there are no important todos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent should derive todos from godService
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent should create
App should create the app
